blocks.text: Alcohols aur phenols hydroxy organic compounds hain jin mein kam az kam ek hydroxyl group (-OH) hota hai. Alcohol mein yeh group aliphatic carbon (ring ke baghair wala carbon) se jura hota hai aur phenol mein aryl carbon (aromatic ring ka carbon) se. Yeh compounds har jagah milte hain (widespread occurrence) aur in ki bohat si applications (istemal) hain, is liye in ka parhna ahem hai. Ethanol ko taqreeban har koi janta hai; isay ethyl alcohol ya grain alcohol bhi kehte hain. Sab jante hain ke alcohols fuel (eendhan) ke taur par istemal ho sakte hain.

Kitab ki tasweeron mein: Left (baen taraf), alcohol bio-based materials (paudon se milne wali cheezein, jaise ganna) se banta hai aur biofuel ke taur par istemal hota hai. Right (daen taraf), phenol disinfectants (jaraseem maarne wali cheezon), jaise sabun aur hospital ke disinfectant liquids, ka hissa hai.

Louis Pasteur ki research se pata chala ke bacteria maujood hain. Is ke baad 1867 mein scientists ne surgical instruments (operation ke auzaar) aur zakhm phenol ke solution se saaf karna shuru kiye. Phenol ki potent (bohat tez) antiseptic (jaraseem maarne wali) property ki wajah se mareez ke operation ke baad bachne ke chances bohat barh gaye. Lekin phenol sehatmand tissues ko bhi jala deta hai, is liye yeh is kaam ke liye zaroorat se zyada tez (too potent) tha, aur aakhir kaar is ke alternatives (doosre options) dhoond liye gaye.

blocks.prompt: Alcohol aur phenol mein kya farq hai?
blocks.explanation: Alcohol mein -OH group aliphatic carbon (ring ke baghair wala carbon) se jura hota hai; phenol mein -OH seedha aromatic ring ke carbon (aryl carbon) se jura hota hai.

items: Hydroxy compounds mein kam az kam ek -OH group hota hai: aliphatic carbon par ho to alcohol, aryl carbon par ho to phenol.
Ethanol (ethyl alcohol, grain alcohol) fuel aur biofuel hai; phenol disinfectants mein istemal hota hai.
1867 se phenol antiseptic ke taur par istemal hua, lekin sehatmand tissue jalane ki wajah se is ki jagah halki (kam tez) cheezein aa gayin.
